      "pass_anchor": "The response must identify the active Loretto DSP/premises (by the premises or DSP identifier and/or its 3350 Burks Spring Road location) and the target amendment AMD-DSP184-PROCESS-2025 (case TTB-AMD-2025-0917, PROCESS, required_before_operation true), linked to AUTH-DSP184-PROCESS-2025. It must report the key before/after facts: the amendment was CLOSED while the linked authorization was PENDING, then the amendment became FILED while that authorization stayed PENDING. It must state that only this amendment was updated to FILED effective September 24, 2025, and that the administrative note records the still-pending linked authorization and open launch gate/no changed operations before the required amendment and supporting evidence are closed. Exact county, state/ZIP formatting, evidence-reference, or other nonessential location fields are not required when the core registry join is clear."

  "check_code": "import sqlite3\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\n\nTARGET = \"AMD-DSP184-PROCESS-2025\"\nAUTHORIZATION = \"AUTH-DSP184-PROCESS-2025\"\nPREMISES = \"DSP-MM-LORETTO-3350-BURKS-SPRING\"\n\n\ndef _db_path(workspace):\n    workspace = Path(workspace)\n    candidates = [\n        workspace.parent / \"system\" / \"ttb_permits_registry\" / \"state.db\",\n        workspace / \"..\" / \"system\" / \"ttb_permits_registry\" / \"state.db\",\n    ]\n    for candidate in candidates:\n        if candidate.exists():\n            return candidate.resolve()\n    raise FileNotFoundError(\"ttb_permits_registry state.db not found\")\n\n\ndef _connect(workspace):\n    con = sqlite3.connect(_db_path(workspace))\n    con.row_factory = sqlite3.Row\n    return con\n\n\ndef check_target_amendment(workspace):\n    with _connect(workspace) as con:\n        row = con.execute(\n            \"SELECT amendment_id, premises_id, authorization_id, case_status, \"\n            \"required_before_operation FROM amendment_cases WHERE amendment_id = ?\",\n            (TARGET,),\n        ).fetchone()\n    expected = (TARGET, PREMISES, AUTHORIZATION, \"FILED\", 1)\n    actual = tuple(row) if row else None\n    if actual == expected:\n        return {\"score\": 1, \"detail\": \"Target process amendment is FILED with the required links preserved.\"}\n    return {\"score\": 0, \"detail\": f\"Target amendment post-state mismatch: expected {expected}, got {actual}.\"}\n\n\ndef check_linked_authorization_unchanged(workspace):\n    with _connect(workspace) as con:\n        row = con.execute(\n            \"SELECT authorization_id, premises_id, operation_code, effective_date, \"\n            \"expiration_date, authorization_status, evidence_reference \"\n            \"FROM permit_authorizations WHERE authorization_id = ?\",\n            (AUTHORIZATION,),\n        ).fetchone()\n    expected = (AUTHORIZATION, PREMISES, \"PROCESS\", \"2025-08-15\", None, \"PENDING\", \"TTB-FILE-5100-24-2025-091\")\n    actual = tuple(row) if row else None\n    if actual == expected:\n        return {\"score\": 1, \"detail\": \"Linked process authorization is unchanged and remains PENDING.\"}\n    return {\"score\": 0, \"detail\": f\"Linked authorization changed: expected {expected}, got {actual}.\"}\n\n\ndef check_other_loretto_amendments_unchanged(workspace):\n    expected = {\n        \"AMD-DSP184-ADDRESS-2024\": \"APPROVED\",\n        \"AMD-DSP184-EQUIP-2025\": \"FILED\",\n    }\n    with _connect(workspace) as con:\n        rows = con.execute(\n            \"SELECT amendment_id, case_status FROM amendment_cases \"\n            \"WHERE amendment_id IN (?, ?) ORDER BY amendment_id\",\n            tuple(expected),\n        ).fetchall()\n    actual = {row[\"amendment_id\"]: row[\"case_status\"] for row in rows}\n    if actual == expected:\n        return {\"score\": 1, \"detail\": \"Other Loretto amendments retain their pre-task statuses.\"}\n    return {\"score\": 0, \"detail\": f\"Other Loretto amendment statuses changed: expected {expected}, got {actual}.\"}\n",
